title: AIR GEAR Special
justification: AniList 3791 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2007-03-21) is AniDB 4196's special S1 Special Trick, aired 2007-03-21. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 857, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 4196, and the special's title matches AniList's English title (Air Gear: Special Trick) and synonym. The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 Episode 21.5: Special Trick (2007-03-21) and on TMDB 31670 S0E1 Episode 21.5: Special Trick (2007-03-21).
